name: Meeedly
description_en:
Meeedly is a product in the AI meeting assistants category. Its directory profile covers Calendar Sync, Video Conferencing, Collaboration Tools.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large) Individuals. API support is listed as Not available. Support channels are listed as Business Hours, Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: keep events aligned between connected calendars; hold meetings using live video connections; support shared work and communication between participants. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
Meeedly 属于AI 会议辅助软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括日历同步、视频会议、协作工具。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务）。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织 个人用户。API 支持情况为未提供。资料所列支持方式为工作时间支持, 在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：未提供免费试用。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：同步已连接日历中的事件；通过实时视频连接举行会议；支持多人共同工作和沟通。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
